data.title: Pronouns — Starter · Lesson 6
data.subject: pronouns
data.lyrics:
"""
[Intro]
¡Vamos a la playa!

[Hook]
Waves are crashing… Las olas rompen
Let's dive in… Vamos a nadar
Sunshine's perfect… El sol es perfecto
You and me… Tú y yo
On this sunny day.

[Verse]
Feel the breeze… Siente la brisa
Me… me, you… tú, sí… yes
We are here… Nosotros estamos aquí
Vosotros… you all, having fun.
Ellos… they (masculine), ellas… they (feminine)
Ustedes… you all (formal), with the sun shining bright.
Consigo… with oneself, enjoying the day
Os… you (object pronoun, informal), let's play.
Yo… I, te… you, bajo el cielo azul
Walking on the sand.

[Hook]
Waves are crashing… Las olas rompen
Let's dive in… Vamos a nadar
Sunshine's perfect… El sol es perfecto
You and me… Tú y yo
On this sunny day.

[Verse]
Building castles… Construimos castillos
La risa… the laughter, filling the air.
Con mis amigos… with my friends
We share the joy… compartimos la alegría.
El mar… the sea, calling our names
Vamos… let's go, into the waves.
El sol nos abraza… the sun hugs us
